title: A Rational Point Opens a Door
mathematical_role: Render the exact elliptic curve E₅, a verified rational point, and the corresponding exact rational right triangle as two views of one arithmetic example while preserving the finite-search boundary.
learning_objective: Connect y²=x³−25x and P=(25/4,75/8) to an area-five rational right triangle, and remember that one exact witness is not a complete description of E₅(Q).
literal_semantics: The plotted curve is deterministically sampled from y²=x³−25x over the recorded display window.
P=(25/4,75/8) and its reflected real point are generated from the exact curve equation; P is labelled.
The right triangle has exact side lengths 3/2, 20/3, and 41/6.
The displayed area calculation 1/2·(3/2)·(20/3)=5 is exact.
nonliteral_semantics: The finite plotted real-curve window is not the whole real or rational point set.
Sampling density, line interpolation, panel placement, color, and atmospheric styling are rendering choices.
No additional visible location is asserted to be rational unless labelled.

notes: Curve samples are generated from the exact polynomial; the distinguished point and triangle are exact constants in the renderer.

renderer.version_or_environment: Python 3 standard library; deterministic BSD literary SVG renderer v2
reproducibility_notes: No randomness or external service is used.
The renderer reproduces the committed BSD candidate byte-for-byte.
Rendering reproducibility does not establish rank, completeness, or BSD.

derivatives.role: data-derived literary vector master; bounded review candidate only

accessibility.alt_text: A dark exact plot of E5, y squared equals x cubed minus 25x, marks P equals 25 over 4 comma 75 over 8 and points toward a right triangle with exact sides 3 over 2, 20 over 3, and 41 over 6 and area five.
accessibility.long_description: The dominant panel is a deterministic real plot of E5 with the exact rational point P highlighted. Beside it, a luminous inset shows the exact area-five rational right triangle. A lower panel states that the point is literal data, the window is finite, and neither establishes the complete Mordell-Weil group or BSD.

claim_boundary.strongest_visual_claim: Reproducible exposition of the source-stated congruent-number-five example and one verified rational point.

supersession_reason: Replaces an aesthetic cubic substitute with the exact curve, point, and triangle while restoring the sense of arithmetic wonder present in the literary reference.
